Tikal.name: Chak Tok Ich'aak I
Tikal.note: Died the day Teotihuacan forces arrived.
Tikal.note_zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎军队到达当天去世。

Tikal.name: Yax Nuun Ahiin I
Tikal.note_zh: 在特奥蒂瓦坎扶持下即位。

Tikal.name: Siyaj Chan K'awiil II
Tikal.name_zh: 西亚赫·查恩·卡威尔二世

Tikal.name: Jasaw Chan K'awiil I
Tikal.note: Defeated Calakmul in 695 and restored Tikal's power.
Tikal.note_zh: 695年击败卡拉克穆尔，重振蒂卡尔。

Calakmul.name: Yuknoom Ch'een II
Calakmul.note: Made Calakmul the leading power of the Maya lowlands.
Calakmul.note_zh: 使卡拉克穆尔成为玛雅低地的霸主。

Palenque.name: K'inich Janaab Pakal I
Palenque.note: Built the Temple of the Inscriptions, where he was buried.
Palenque.note_zh: 修建了碑铭神庙，死后葬于庙下。

Copán.name: Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil
Copán.note: Patron of Copán's finest stelae, captured and killed by Quiriguá.
Copán.note_zh: 主持雕刻科潘最精美的石碑，后被基里瓜俘杀。

people.name: K'inich Janaab Pakal
people.known_for: King of Palenque for 68 years, whose rich tomb lies under the Temple of the Inscriptions.
people.known_for_zh: 帕伦克国王，在位68年，其华丽的墓室位于碑铭神庙之下，出土了著名的玉面具。

people.name: Siyaj K'ahk'
people.known_for: Teotihuacan war leader who arrived at Tikal in 378 and put a new king on its throne.
people.known_for_zh: 来自特奥蒂瓦坎的军事首领，378年到达蒂卡尔并扶立新王，改变了玛雅政治格局。

people.name: Jasaw Chan K'awiil I
people.known_for: King of Tikal who defeated Calakmul and built the great Temple I.
people.known_for_zh: 蒂卡尔国王，击败宿敌卡拉克穆尔，修建了著名的一号神庙。

people.name: Yuknoom Ch'een II
people.known_for: King of Calakmul, called Yuknoom the Great, who built a network of allied Maya cities.
people.known_for_zh: 卡拉克穆尔国王，人称“伟大的尤克努姆”，建立了庞大的玛雅城邦联盟网络。

people.name: Lady Six Sky
people.known_for: Princess from Dos Pilas who ruled Naranjo and led its wars.
people.known_for_zh: 来自多斯皮拉斯的公主，统治纳兰霍城邦并亲自主持战争。

people.name: Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil
people.known_for: King of Copán, called 18 Rabbit, under whom the city's famous carved stelae were made.
people.known_for_zh: 科潘国王，俗称“十八兔”，在位期间雕成了科潘最著名的石碑。

Toltec Empire.name: Topiltzin Quetzalcoatl
Toltec Empire.name_zh: 托皮尔岑·克察尔科亚特尔
Toltec Empire.note: Half-legendary priest-king, later merged with the feathered serpent god.
Toltec Empire.note_zh: 半传说的祭司王，后来与羽蛇神的传说融为一体。

Mixtecs.name: Eight Deer Jaguar Claw
Mixtecs.note: United much of the Mixtec region, as told in the Mixtec codices.
Mixtecs.note_zh: 据米斯特克古抄本记载，他统一了米斯特克地区大部。

people.name: Topiltzin Quetzalcoatl
people.name_zh: 托皮尔岑·克察尔科亚特尔
people.known_for: Half-legendary Toltec priest-king of Tula, remembered in Aztec tradition as a wise ruler.
people.known_for_zh: 半传说的托尔特克祭司王，在阿兹特克传说中是图拉的贤明君主。

people.name: Eight Deer Jaguar Claw
people.known_for: Mixtec ruler whose conquests are told in painted codices.
people.known_for_zh: 米斯特克统治者，他的征战事迹记载在彩绘古抄本中。

Tenochtitlan.name: Tenoch
Tenochtitlan.note_zh: 传说中特诺奇蒂特兰的建立者。

Azcapotzalco.name: Tezozomoc
Azcapotzalco.note: Tepanec king who dominated the Valley of Mexico, with the Mexica as his vassals.
Azcapotzalco.note_zh: 特帕内克国王，称霸墨西哥谷地，墨西加人当时是其附庸。

people.name: Tezozomoc
people.known_for: Long-reigning Tepanec king who ruled most of the Valley of Mexico.
people.known_for_zh: 长期在位的特帕内克国王，统治了墨西哥谷地的大部分地区。

people.name: Acamapichtli
people.known_for: First tlatoani of Tenochtitlan, whose Toltec-linked lineage gave Mexica kings their legitimacy.
people.known_for_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰第一位特拉托阿尼，其托尔特克血统为墨西加王室奠定了正统性。

Aztec Empire.name: Ahuitzotl
Aztec Empire.note: Pushed the empire to its greatest extent.
Aztec Empire.note_zh: 将帝国版图扩张到最大。

Aztec Empire.name: Cuauhtémoc
Aztec Empire.note: Last ruler, captured by Cortés in 1521.
Aztec Empire.note_zh: 末代君主，1521年被科尔特斯俘获。

people.name: Nezahualcoyotl
people.known_for: Philosopher-king of Texcoco, famous as a poet and builder of laws and aqueducts.
people.known_for_zh: 特斯科科的“哲人王”，以诗歌闻名，并制定法律、修建水道。

people.name: Tlacaelel
people.known_for: Chief adviser to several Aztec kings who shaped the empire's state religion of the sun god.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐多位阿兹特克君主的重臣，确立了以太阳神崇拜为核心的帝国宗教。

people.name: Moctezuma II
people.known_for: Aztec emperor at the height of the empire, who received Cortés in 1519 and died as his captive.
people.known_for_zh: 阿兹特克帝国鼎盛时的皇帝，1519年接待科尔特斯，后在被软禁中死去。

people.name: Cuauhtémoc
people.known_for: Last Aztec emperor, who led the defence of Tenochtitlan in 1521.
people.known_for_zh: 阿兹特克末代皇帝，1521年领导保卫特诺奇蒂特兰的战斗，今天被墨西哥奉为民族英雄。

people.name: Ahuitzotl
people.known_for: Aztec emperor whose campaigns carried the empire to the Guatemalan border.
people.known_for_zh: 阿兹特克皇帝，率军征战，把帝国疆域扩展到今危地马拉边境。

people.name: Vasco Núñez de Balboa
people.name_zh: 巴斯克·努涅斯·德巴尔沃亚
people.known_for: Spanish explorer who crossed Panama in 1513 and was the first European to see the Pacific from the Americas.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙探险家，1513年横穿巴拿马地峡，是第一个从美洲望见太平洋的欧洲人。

people.name: Francisco Hernández de Córdoba
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·埃尔南德斯·德科尔多瓦
people.known_for: Spanish explorer who reached Yucatán in 1517 and first met the Maya.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙探险家，1517年到达尤卡坦半岛，首次与玛雅人接触。

Viceroyalty of New Spain.name: Charles I
Viceroyalty of New Spain.note: Also Holy Roman Emperor as Charles V.
Viceroyalty of New Spain.note_zh: 同时是神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世。

Viceroyalty of New Spain.name: Philip V
Viceroyalty of New Spain.note: Briefly abdicated for his son Louis I in 1724.
Viceroyalty of New Spain.note_zh: 1724年曾短暂让位给儿子路易斯一世。

Viceroyalty of New Spain.name: Ferdinand VII
Viceroyalty of New Spain.note: Held captive by Napoleon from 1808 to 1813.

people.name: Hernán Cortés
people.known_for: Spanish conquistador who overthrew the Aztec Empire in 1521.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙征服者，1521年灭亡阿兹特克帝国，开启西班牙对墨西哥的统治。

people.name: La Malinche
people.known_for: Nahua woman who served Cortés as interpreter and adviser during the conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 纳瓦族女子，在征服过程中为科尔特斯担任翻译和顾问。

people.name: Pedro de Alvarado
people.known_for: Conquistador who conquered the highland Maya of Guatemala.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙征服者，征服了危地马拉高原的玛雅人，任危地马拉总督。

people.name: Antonio de Mendoza
people.known_for: First viceroy of New Spain, from 1535 to 1550, who set up its government and mint.
people.known_for_zh: 新西班牙第一任总督，1535年至1550年在任，建立了殖民地政府和铸币厂。

people.name: Bartolomé de las Casas
people.name_zh: 巴托洛梅·德拉斯·卡萨斯
people.known_for: Dominican friar and bishop of Chiapas who denounced Spanish cruelty to the native peoples.
people.known_for_zh: 多明我会修士、恰帕斯主教，揭露西班牙人对印第安人的暴行，为其权利奔走。

works.title: A Short Account of the Destruction of the Indies

people.name: Juan de Zumárraga
people.known_for: First bishop of Mexico, who brought the first printing press to the Americas.
people.known_for_zh: 墨西哥第一任主教，把第一台印刷机引入美洲。

people.name: Juan Diego
people.known_for: Nahua man whose vision of the Virgin of Guadalupe in 1531 became central to Mexican Catholicism.
people.known_for_zh: 纳瓦族教徒，据说1531年见到瓜达卢佩圣母显现，成为墨西哥天主教信仰的核心。

people.name: Bernardino de Sahagún
people.known_for: Franciscan friar who recorded Aztec life and beliefs with native scholars in Nahuatl.
people.known_for_zh: 方济各会修士，与印第安学者一起用纳瓦特尔语记录阿兹特克人的生活和信仰。

people.name: Bernal Díaz del Castillo
people.name_zh: 贝尔纳尔·迪亚斯·德尔卡斯蒂略
people.known_for: Soldier with Cortés who later wrote an eyewitness history of the conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 跟随科尔特斯的士兵，晚年写下征服墨西哥的亲历记。

works.title: The True History of the Conquest of New Spain

people.name: Vasco de Quiroga
people.known_for: Bishop of Michoacán who organised native towns on the model of Thomas More's Utopia.
people.known_for_zh: 米却肯主教，仿照莫尔的《乌托邦》组织印第安人村镇，教授手工技艺。

people.name: Andrés de Urdaneta
people.known_for: Navigator who found the return route across the Pacific in 1565, opening the Manila galleon trade.
people.known_for_zh: 航海家，1565年找到横渡太平洋的东返航线，开启了马尼拉大帆船贸易。

people.name: Juana Inés de la Cruz
people.name_zh: 胡安娜·伊内斯·德拉克鲁斯
people.known_for: Nun and poet, the greatest writer of colonial Spanish America.
people.known_for_zh: 修女和诗人，西属美洲殖民时期最杰出的作家。

people.name: Carlos de Sigüenza y Góngora
people.name_zh: 卡洛斯·德西古恩萨-贡戈拉
people.known_for: Mexican scholar of mathematics, astronomy and Aztec history.
people.known_for_zh: 墨西哥学者，研究数学、天文学和阿兹特克历史。

people.name: Miguel Cabrera
people.known_for: Leading painter of New Spain, known for his portrait of Sor Juana.
people.known_for_zh: 新西班牙最著名的画家，以胡安娜修女肖像和“种姓画”闻名。

people.name: Junípero Serra
people.known_for: Franciscan friar who founded the first Spanish missions in California.
people.known_for_zh: 方济各会修士，在加利福尼亚建立了第一批西班牙传教站。

people.name: Francisco Javier Clavijero
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·克拉维赫罗
people.known_for: Jesuit historian whose history of ancient Mexico was written in exile in Italy.
people.known_for_zh: 耶稣会历史学家，流亡意大利期间写成《墨西哥古代史》。

people.name: Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla
people.known_for: Priest whose Cry of Dolores in 1810 began the Mexican War of Independence.
people.known_for_zh: 神父，1810年发出“多洛雷斯呼声”，发动墨西哥独立战争，被尊为“墨西哥国父”。

people.name: José María Morelos
people.known_for: Priest who led the independence war after Hidalgo and called for an end to slavery and castes.
people.known_for_zh: 神父，继伊达尔戈之后领导独立战争，主张废除奴隶制和种姓制度。

Mexico.name: Agustín de Iturbide
Mexico.name_zh: 阿古斯丁·德伊图尔比德

Mexico.name: Antonio López de Santa Anna
Mexico.name_zh: 安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德圣安纳
Mexico.note: Held the presidency many times between 1833 and 1855.

Mexico.name: Benito Juárez
Mexico.note: Led the republic against the French and Maximilian's empire.
Mexico.note_zh: 领导共和国抵抗法国干涉和马克西米连帝国。

Mexico.name: Sebastián Lerdo de Tejada
Mexico.name_zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·莱尔多·德特哈达

Second Mexican Empire.name: Maximilian I
Second Mexican Empire.note: Austrian archduke put on the throne by France, shot in 1867.
Second Mexican Empire.note_zh: 由法国扶上皇位的奥地利大公，1867年被处决。

Guatemala.name: Justo Rufino Barrios
Guatemala.name_zh: 胡斯托·鲁菲诺·巴里奥斯

Guatemala.name: Manuel Estrada Cabrera
Guatemala.name_zh: 曼努埃尔·埃斯特拉达·卡夫雷拉

people.name: Agustín de Iturbide
people.name_zh: 阿古斯丁·德伊图尔比德
people.known_for: Officer who won Mexican independence in 1821 and briefly ruled as emperor.
people.known_for_zh: 军官，1821年实现墨西哥独立，随后短暂称帝。

people.name: Vicente Guerrero
people.known_for: Insurgent leader of the independence war who as president abolished slavery in 1829.
people.known_for_zh: 独立战争中的起义军领袖，任总统期间于1829年废除奴隶制。

people.name: Antonio López de Santa Anna
people.name_zh: 安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德圣安纳
people.known_for: General and many-times president who lost Texas and the war with the United States.
people.known_for_zh: 将军，多次出任总统，任内丢失得克萨斯并在美墨战争中战败。

people.name: Francisco Morazán
people.known_for: Honduran-born president of the Federal Republic of Central America who fought to keep it united.
people.known_for_zh: 洪都拉斯人，中美洲联邦共和国总统，为维护中美洲统一而奋斗。

people.name: Benito Juárez
people.known_for: Zapotec lawyer and president who led the liberal Reform and defeated the French intervention.
people.known_for_zh: 萨波特克族出身的总统，领导自由派改革并击败法国干涉，被誉为墨西哥民族英雄。

people.name: Ignacio Zaragoza
people.known_for: General who beat the French army at Puebla on 5 May 1862.
people.known_for_zh: 将军，1862年5月5日在普埃布拉击败法军，此日后成为“五月五日节”。

people.name: William Walker
people.known_for: American adventurer who made himself president of Nicaragua in 1856.
people.known_for_zh: 美国冒险家，1856年在尼加拉瓜自立为总统，后被中美洲联军赶走并处决。

people.name: José María Velasco
people.known_for: Landscape painter of the Valley of Mexico.
people.known_for_zh: 风景画家，以描绘墨西哥谷地的壮阔景色著称。

people.name: José Guadalupe Posada
people.known_for: Printmaker whose skeleton figure La Catrina became a symbol of the Day of the Dead.
people.known_for_zh: 版画家，他创作的骷髅形象“卡特里娜”成为亡灵节的象征。

people.name: Rubén Darío
people.known_for: Nicaraguan poet who founded modernismo in Spanish-language poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 尼加拉瓜诗人，西班牙语诗歌“现代主义”运动的开创者。

people.name: Justo Sierra
people.known_for: Educator and historian who refounded the National University of Mexico in 1910.
people.known_for_zh: 教育家和历史学家，1910年重建墨西哥国立大学。

Mexico.name: Francisco León de la Barra
Mexico.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·莱昂·德拉巴拉

Mexico.name: Venustiano Carranza
Mexico.note: Constitutionalist leader, president under the 1917 Constitution from 1917.
Mexico.note_zh: 立宪派领袖，1917年起依新宪法任总统。

Mexico.name: Plutarco Elías Calles
Mexico.name_zh: 普卢塔科·埃利亚斯·卡列斯

Mexico.name: Pascual Ortiz Rubio
Mexico.name_zh: 帕斯夸尔·奥尔蒂斯·鲁维奥

Guatemala.name: Manuel Estrada Cabrera
Guatemala.name_zh: 曼努埃尔·埃斯特拉达·卡夫雷拉

Nicaragua.name: Anastasio Somoza García
Nicaragua.name_zh: 阿纳斯塔西奥·索摩查·加西亚
Nicaragua.note: Ruled directly or through others until his assassination.
Nicaragua.note_zh: 直接或通过傀儡统治，直至遇刺。

people.name: Francisco I. Madero
people.known_for: Reformer whose call to revolt in 1910 brought down Díaz; murdered in 1913.
people.known_for_zh: 改革者，1910年号召起义推翻迪亚斯，任总统，1913年遇害。

people.name: Emiliano Zapata
people.known_for: Peasant leader of the south who fought for 'land and liberty'.
people.known_for_zh: 南方农民起义领袖，为“土地与自由”而战。

people.name: Pancho Villa
people.known_for: Revolutionary general of the north who raided Columbus, New Mexico, in 1916.
people.known_for_zh: 北方革命军将领，1916年袭击美国新墨西哥州哥伦布镇。

people.name: Lázaro Cárdenas
people.known_for: President who carried out land reform and nationalised the oil industry in 1938.
people.known_for_zh: 墨西哥总统，大规模推行土地改革，1938年将石油工业收归国有。

people.name: José Vasconcelos
people.known_for: Education minister who spread schools and commissioned the mural movement.
people.known_for_zh: 教育部长，大力兴办学校，资助壁画运动，提出“宇宙种族”思想。

people.name: Diego Rivera
people.known_for: Leading Mexican muralist who painted the history of the Mexican people on public walls.
people.known_for_zh: 墨西哥壁画运动的领军人物，在公共建筑上描绘墨西哥人民的历史。

people.name: Frida Kahlo
people.known_for: Painter of vivid self-portraits drawing on Mexican folk art.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，以融合墨西哥民间艺术的强烈自画像闻名。

people.name: José Clemente Orozco
people.name_zh: 何塞·克莱门特·奥罗斯科
people.known_for: Muralist of dark, powerful scenes of war and suffering.
people.known_for_zh: 壁画家，作品以表现战争和苦难的强烈画面著称。

people.name: David Alfaro Siqueiros
people.name_zh: 大卫·阿尔法罗·西凯罗斯
people.known_for: Muralist and political activist, one of the three great Mexican muralists.
people.known_for_zh: 壁画家和政治活动家，墨西哥三大壁画家之一。

people.name: Mariano Azuela
people.known_for: Doctor and novelist of the Mexican Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 医生和作家，墨西哥革命小说的开创者。

people.name: Augusto César Sandino
people.name_zh: 奥古斯托·塞萨尔·桑地诺
people.known_for: Nicaraguan rebel who fought the US Marines from 1927 to 1933.
people.known_for_zh: 尼加拉瓜起义领袖，1927年至1933年领导游击战抗击美国海军陆战队。

people.name: Farabundo Martí
people.known_for: Salvadoran communist executed after the peasant uprising of 1932.
people.known_for_zh: 萨尔瓦多共产党人，1932年农民起义后被处决。

Mexico.name: Manuel Ávila Camacho
Mexico.name_zh: 曼努埃尔·阿维拉·卡马乔

Mexico.name: Miguel Alemán Valdés
Mexico.name_zh: 米格尔·阿莱曼·巴尔德斯

Mexico.name: Adolfo Ruiz Cortines
Mexico.name_zh: 阿道弗·鲁伊斯·科蒂内斯

Mexico.name: Adolfo López Mateos
Mexico.name_zh: 阿道弗·洛佩斯·马特奥斯

Mexico.name: Gustavo Díaz Ordaz
Mexico.name_zh: 古斯塔沃·迪亚斯·奥尔达斯

Mexico.name: Carlos Salinas de Gortari
Mexico.name_zh: 卡洛斯·萨利纳斯·德戈塔里

Mexico.name: Andrés Manuel López Obrador
Mexico.name_zh: 安德烈斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·奥夫拉多尔

Nicaragua.name: Anastasio Somoza García
Nicaragua.name_zh: 阿纳斯塔西奥·索摩查·加西亚
Nicaragua.note: Ruled directly or through others until his assassination.
Nicaragua.note_zh: 直接或通过傀儡统治，直至遇刺。

Nicaragua.name: Luis Somoza Debayle
Nicaragua.name_zh: 路易斯·索摩查·德瓦伊莱

Nicaragua.name: Anastasio Somoza Debayle
Nicaragua.name_zh: 阿纳斯塔西奥·索摩查·德瓦伊莱

people.name: Octavio Paz
people.known_for: Poet and essayist on Mexican identity, Nobel Prize in Literature 1990.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和散文家，探讨墨西哥民族性，1990年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Juan Rulfo
people.known_for: Writer whose single novel inspired the magical realism of Latin America.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，仅有的一部长篇小说启发了拉丁美洲的魔幻现实主义。

people.name: Carlos Fuentes
people.known_for: Novelist of the Latin American Boom.
people.known_for_zh: 拉丁美洲“文学爆炸”的代表作家。

works.title: The Death of Artemio Cruz
works.title_zh: 阿尔特米奥·克罗斯之死

people.name: Luis Barragán
people.known_for: Architect of colourful walls, light and water, winner of the Pritzker Prize in 1980.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，善用彩色墙面、光线和水，1980年获普利兹克建筑奖。

people.name: Rufino Tamayo
people.known_for: Zapotec painter who blended pre-Hispanic art with modern painting.
people.known_for_zh: 萨波特克族画家，把前西班牙时期艺术与现代绘画融为一体。

people.name: Norman Borlaug
people.known_for: American agronomist whose high-yield wheat bred in Mexico started the Green Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 美国农学家，在墨西哥培育出高产小麦，开启“绿色革命”，1970年获诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Miguel Ángel Asturias
people.name_zh: 米格尔·安赫尔·阿斯图里亚斯
people.known_for: Guatemalan novelist, Nobel Prize in Literature 1967.
people.known_for_zh: 危地马拉小说家，1967年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Jacobo Árbenz
people.known_for: Guatemalan president whose land reform led to his overthrow in a CIA-backed coup in 1954.
people.known_for_zh: 危地马拉总统，推行土地改革，1954年在美国中情局支持的政变中被推翻。

people.name: Óscar Romero
people.known_for: Archbishop of San Salvador who spoke for the poor and was shot while saying Mass.
people.known_for_zh: 圣萨尔瓦多大主教，为穷人发声，1980年在主持弥撒时遇刺。

people.name: Omar Torrijos
people.known_for: Panamanian leader who signed the 1977 treaties returning the Panama Canal to Panama.
people.known_for_zh: 巴拿马领导人，1977年签订条约，使巴拿马运河最终归还巴拿马。

people.name: José Figueres Ferrer
people.known_for: Costa Rican leader who abolished the army in 1948.
people.known_for_zh: 哥斯达黎加领导人，1948年废除军队，奠定该国民主传统。

people.name: Ernesto Cardenal
people.known_for: Nicaraguan priest-poet of liberation theology.
people.known_for_zh: 尼加拉瓜神父诗人，解放神学的代表人物。

people.name: Cantinflas
people.known_for: Comic film actor, the most loved figure of Mexican cinema's golden age.
people.known_for_zh: 喜剧电影演员，墨西哥电影黄金时代最受欢迎的明星。

people.name: Mario J. Molina
people.known_for: Mexican chemist who showed that CFCs destroy the ozone layer, Nobel Prize in Chemistry 1995.
people.known_for_zh: 墨西哥化学家，发现氟氯烃破坏臭氧层，1995年获诺贝尔化学奖。
